races.name: Andy Calvert Celebration Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Bobby Socks
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning after 470 days off but has winning form fresh and cheekpieces should sharpen him up

runners_data.name: Stay In The Game
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer who won well last time and looks well-treated off this mark with quick reappearance

runners_data.name: Zephlyn
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse suited by this trip but 50-day break and tongue-tie first time adds questions

runners_data.name: Les's Legacy
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with solid recent form who benefits from the 7lb claimer but needs strong pace

runners_data.name: Character Testing
runners_data.note: Improving hold-up type who stays well but has never won over hurdles despite consistent placings

runners_data.name: Newport
runners_data.note: Front-running type who lacks pace to dominate but has shown improved form in cheekpieces recently

runners_data.name: Curious Mrs Fox
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer stepping back up in trip after 40-day break with useful 7lb weight allowance

runners_data.name: National Question
runners_data.note: Inconsistent prominent runner who has winning form but trainer's poor strike-rate is concerning

runners_data.name: Malangen
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner in good form but 11-year-old legs may not handle a truly-run finish

runners_data.name: Snapaudaciaheros
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with questions over stamina and form but first-time cheekpieces could provide spark

races.paceDynamic: Bobby Socks and Newport will set a measured early pace from the front, with Malangen and National Question tracking prominently just behind. The lack of natural speed horses means no sustained pressure on the leaders through the early stages, creating a tactical affair that will likely see the pace quicken significantly from three out. Stay In The Game, Zephlyn, Les's Legacy and Character Testing will all need strong finishes from off the pace in what becomes a sprint finish. This measured early tempo heavily favours the hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The patient riders get first run on tiring leaders and the class horses can show their superior finishing speed. Strong stayers with tactical speed benefit most from this searching finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Bobby Socks or Newport can dictate fractions and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The leaders get enough of a break to hold off late challengers on this sharp track. Horses with early pace positioning and stamina reserves prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse commits early and they crawl to three out in single file
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of position. Raw speed from the final flight matters more than tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace War
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too hard trying to dictate terms early
scenarios.body: The leaders tire dramatically and drop away completely in the final half-mile. Only horses held up stone last can pick up the pieces from the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Bobby Socks could be vulnerable to a fast finish if the long layoff has left him short of peak fitness
Stay In The Game's quick reappearance suggests connections are confident but watch for any market drift
National Question has winning form at this level but trainer Adam Nicol has no winners from three runners recently
Character Testing has never won over hurdles despite multiple placings so watch for any betting confidence
Malangen's veteran status at 11 years old makes him vulnerable if the pace becomes truly searching late on

races.name: Clean Sweep Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Nobotheratall
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent form including course win, benefits from tactical pace setup

runners_data.name: All About Moi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 255-day break under capable jockey, needs strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Mr Ramoon
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with fade-in-finish tendency, 149-day absence and 5lb claimer adds uncertainty

runners_data.name: Ribble River
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with good course record, recent form solid and suits tactical scenarios

runners_data.name: Scopic
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with limited winning form on good ground, needs others to go too fast early

runners_data.name: Steps In Time
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up type whose trainer is 0/17 in last fortnight, form figures concerning

runners_data.name: Colinski
runners_data.note: Back-marker with 5lb claimer advantage and first-time cheekpieces, held up running style suits if pace strong

runners_data.name: Autumn Getaway
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5lb claimer claim, trained by in-form Lizzie Quinlan but poor recent efforts

runners_data.name: Obsessedwithyou
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with excellent going record, veteran experience valuable in tactical race

races.paceDynamic: Ribble River will take the field along as the clear pace angle, with Nobotheratall and Obsessedwithyou tracking in prominent positions behind the leader. The modest pace should allow the hold-up brigade of All About Moi, Scopic, Steps In Time, Colinski and Autumn Getaway to settle before launching their challenges. With only one confirmed front runner and no genuine pace pressure, this sets up as a tactical affair that will turn into a sprint from the last hurdle. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, rather than hold-up horses who may find the finishing speed insufficient to reel in the pace-trackers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Nobotheratall and Obsessedwithyou can track Ribble River without getting involved in early battles
scenarios.body: The tactical pace allows them perfect positioning to strike after the last, with their superior recent form and jumping rhythm giving them the edge over the hold-up horses. Their ability to quicken from prominent positions proves decisive when the race develops into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even more sedate than expected and one of the back-markers times their run perfectly
scenarios.body: All About Moi or Scopic gets the ideal patient ride before unleashing a strong late challenge that catches the prominent horses napping. The lack of early pace allows them to close the gap dramatically in the final furlong when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ribble River Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Ribble River can dictate fractions without serious pressure and maintain galloping room throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner utilizes the tactical nature to control the race completely, kicking clear after the last hurdle before the trackers can respond. Lizzie Quinlan's 60% strike-rate with this jockey combination proves crucial in executing the front-running tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy scramble after the last hurdle with the fancied horses failing to fire
scenarios.body: Colinski or Autumn Getaway benefits from the 5lb apprentice allowance and chaos of the finish to grab victory at rewarding odds. Their connections' recent form and the weight advantage proves decisive when the race falls apart tactically.

watchPoints.text: Mr Ramoon could be well behind turning for home given his tendency to fade and long absence under inexperienced jockey
Ribble River's front-running tactics become crucial if no other pace emerges, as sitting ducks rarely win at Hexham
All About Moi's fitness after 255 days off will show in the final furlong when asked for maximum effort
The 5lb apprentice allowances for Colinski and Autumn Getaway could prove significant in a tight finish
Obsessedwithyou's consistency on good ground makes him banker material if getting the tactical race he needs

races.name: Tileform Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Chicago Storm
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to this tactical setup, though 55 days off and jockey's 3lb claim raises slight fitness questions

runners_data.name: Ghasham
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in excellent recent form but needs decent early pace to be effective, headgear suggests temperament management required

runners_data.name: Bentley Road
runners_data.note: Uncertain running style after 35-day break, Derek Fox booking notable given trainer's poor recent strike rate

runners_data.name: Divas Doyen
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who could benefit if Chicago Storm sets it up, carries headgear and significant weight relief at bottom of handicap

runners_data.name: Mr Globalist
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with excellent recent consistency, 3lb claiming jockey and minimum weight could prove decisive in tight finish

runners_data.name: Cross Of Redmoor
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 179-day absence, headgear changes suggest ongoing issues and needs everything to fall right

races.paceDynamic: Chicago Storm appears the only genuine front runner and should dictate terms uncontested early. With Ghasham, Bentley Road, Mr Globalist and Cross Of Redmoor all hold-up types, they'll need Chicago Storm or Divas Doyen to provide adequate pace. The lack of early pace pressure could see a moderate gallop until the business end. This tactical setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can capitalise on a soft lead and kick when the hold-up brigade are still getting organised.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Chicago Storm gets an easy lead and kicks approaching two out
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Chicago Storm to control the race and retain enough energy for a decisive move. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back a class act with first run of jump.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Ghasham's recent good form and hold-up style becomes an asset in a cavalry charge finish. The lack of early gallop means stamina becomes less important than a sharp turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Handicapper Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bentley Road has improved significantly during his 35-day break
scenarios.body: His uncertain running style could be an asset if connections have worked on his jumping and fitness. Derek Fox's booking suggests confidence despite the stable's poor recent record.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Chicago Storm fails to go forward or makes jumping errors early
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge in a messy finish where anything can happen. The race becomes a lottery with lightweight Mr Globalist or Divas Doyen potentially capitalising on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Chicago Storm's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could derail the front-running plan and create pace chaos
Whether Ghasham can overcome the lack of early pace given his hold-up style relies entirely on others providing the gallop
Bentley Road's early positioning will reveal if connections have addressed his uncertain running style during the 35-day break
Mr Globalist and Cross Of Redmoor both need the pace to develop properly to be effective from the rear
Divas Doyen's headgear and weight drop combination could create a different prominent threat to Chicago Storm's dominance

races.name: Lisa Bond Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Miss Maverick
runners_data.note: Front-running style should get uncontested lead but 20-day break and poor trainer form create concerns

runners_data.name: Cannock Park
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 217-day layoff is major negative despite trainer's small string having time to prepare

runners_data.name: Imperial Data
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form but 5lb claimer booking suggests connections lack confidence

runners_data.name: Johnson's Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suits race shape and recent third suggests ready to strike

runners_data.name: Sunset Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in class but headgear applied suggests needing extra help

runners_data.name: Perseus Way
runners_data.note: Hold-up style ideal but 35-day gap since last run on the flat may blunt fitness edge

runners_data.name: Passing Diamond
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent wins but significant class rise poses questions

runners_data.name: Well Educated
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran with 7-day turnaround but bottom weight and good recent form provide hope

races.paceDynamic: Miss Maverick will dictate from the front with minimal pressure, as the other prominent runners (Cannock Park, Imperial Data, Sunset Hill, Passing Diamond) are likely to sit just off the pace rather than engage early. This creates a controlled tempo that should suit the patient hold-up horses. Johnson's Blue, Perseus Way and Well Educated can all travel comfortably in rear before making late moves. The lack of genuine pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Maverick sets uncontested fractions and the prominent runners fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows the back markers to conserve energy and time their challenges perfectly. Johnson's Blue and Perseus Way can unleash decisive late kicks when others have already committed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners clash
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Data and Passing Diamond press Miss Maverick earlier than expected creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents a bunched finish, allowing the most talented prominent runner to maintain momentum. Imperial Data's recent form edge and Passing Diamond's lower weight become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Maverick gets completely uncontested lead and kicks clear before others can respond
scenarios.body: The combination of controlled fractions and tactical awareness allows the leader to build an unassailable advantage. Miss Maverick's course experience and sustainable racing style prove decisive in the testing ground conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from the rear
scenarios.trigger: If Well Educated gets the perfect trip as favorites disappoint or make tactical errors
scenarios.body: The veteran's low weight and fresh recent run allow him to pick up the pieces when higher-rated rivals falter. Well Educated benefits from a truly-run race that plays to his stamina strengths.

watchPoints.text: Perseus Way's flat-to-hurdles transition after 35-day gap could see fitness levels questioned if struggling to keep pace
Imperial Data's 5lb claimer booking despite solid form suggests stable may have doubts about winning chances
Cannock Park returning after 217-day absence faces significant fitness test against race-fit rivals
Miss Maverick's early fractions will dictate entire race shape - if going too fast early, hold-up horses benefit more
Well Educated's quick 7-day turnaround after decent effort could catch higher-rated rivals off guard

runners_data.name: Lets Mingle

runners_data.name: Beny Nahar Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer wearing tongue-tie, inconsistent recent form but has shown ability at this level previously

runners_data.name: Wee Alki

runners_data.name: Divilabother

races.paceDynamic: Campaign Trail and Supreme Yeats will likely lead the field early, with Billy Boi Blue, Wee Alki and Divilabother also keen to race prominently. The presence of multiple front-runners suggests a solid gallop throughout this extended 2m7½f trip. Campaign Trail's recent win suggests he can dictate from the front without being harassed early. This genuine pace and stamina test will favour horses that can settle and stay, particularly those with hold-up tactics who can capitalise on a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong with multiple prominent runners going at it
scenarios.body: The gallop will stretch the field and tire the leaders, allowing patient rides to sweep past in the final half-mile. Pinot Rouge and Beny Nahar Road can capitalise on their hold-up styles despite recent disappointing form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runners dominate completely
scenarios.trigger: If Campaign Trail gets an easy lead with minimal pressure from other prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes tactical and sustainable, allowing the early leaders to kick clear when it matters. Campaign Trail's recent win and Supreme Yeats' dual victories show they can sustain their efforts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent settlers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but controlled, suiting horses just off the leaders
scenarios.body: Billy Boi Blue and Wee Alki can track the leaders without being caught up in early speed battles. Their prominent but not necessarily leading styles allow them to conserve energy for a late challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexposed improver emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Lets Mingle's uncertain running style proves more effective than recent form suggests
scenarios.body: The 6-year-old's versatility and lighter weight could prove decisive if the race develops into a tactical affair. Jack Power's 5lb claim provides additional assistance in a competitive handicap.

watchPoints.text: Campaign Trail may get an uncontested lead if other prominent runners don't engage early enough
Supreme Yeats' age at 10 years old could tell against him in a competitive handicap despite recent wins
Pinot Rouge's hold-up style could be perfectly suited if the early pace is strong as expected
Jack Power's 5lb claim on Lets Mingle adds extra significance to any market support for the unexposed type
Billy Boi Blue's trainer combination has a solid 2/8 record over the past 14 days suggesting stable form

runners_data.name: Jet Light

races.paceDynamic: Killybegs Jet Lady will lead from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field, creating a sustainable gallop over three miles. Passengerontheship and Dr Shirocco may track her in second and third, but neither is aggressive enough to apply early pressure. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be controlled rather than searching, with the real racing beginning after the final fence. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as the leaders will have plenty left in reserve turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Killybegs Jet Lady sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The controlled gallop plays into the hands of closers who time their run perfectly after the last fence. A Year Older and The Kings Soldier benefit most from being able to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runners capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Killybegs Jet Lady and Passengerontheship establish a working pace from early
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners stretch the field and their stamina advantage over three miles proves decisive. Killybegs Jet Lady's recent good form and Passengerontheship's course experience become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race collapse scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders set too strong a pace and fold dramatically after two-out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whatever horses remain with energy, regardless of their usual running style. This chaos scenario could throw up an unexpected winner from the trailing group.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical stalemate finish
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make the running and they crawl along throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with multiple horses still in contention at the last, turning into a pure staying test. The horse with the most stamina rather than speed will prevail in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Killybegs Jet Lady if she gets an uncontested lead and Alan Doyle's 3lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish
A Year Older's jumping under pressure given his front-running tendencies may clash with the early pace scenario
The pace through the first mile will determine everything - watch for any horse trying to go with Killybegs Jet Lady early
Passengerontheship's ability to track the leader without getting into a speed duel that compromises his stamina
Any market moves on The Kings Soldier given Oscar Palmer's 7lb claim and the horse's improving trajectory
